confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are ballpark. Search results summarizing 2026 El Nido price guides and cost indexes broadly agree on restaurant meals but conflict on beer, cocktails and wine, several figures are undated or older, and most come from one hotel-ranking site. Peso figures were converted to USD at a rate implied by those sources, not separately checked. Wine is the weakest drink anchor, so it was set at roughly four times the beer anchor and checked against house-wine listings. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no lodging search or listings checked, set for July green-season rates. They are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city dataset was used. Food and drink anchors rest on El Nido-specific aggregated price ranges from search results. Accommodation anchors are a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Palawan beach-town pricing.
